summary: Outputs solved Bullet Dynamics transform, velocity, body, actor, active, and collision channels from a Bullet Solver COMP or Actor COMP.
key_concepts: Reads solved results from a Bullet Dynamics system by referencing either a Bullet Solver COMP for the full system or an Actor COMP for one actor.
Outputs actor_id, body_id, active state, optional collision fields, transforms, scale, linear velocity, and angular velocity channels.
Collision Info adds colliding_actor_id, colliding_body_id, and total collision channels, and requires Perform Contact Test on the Bullet Solver COMP.
Transform Space chooses whether translation and rotation outputs are relative to world, the Bullet Solver COMP, or the Actor COMP.
The CHOP can be fed back through Bullet Solver COMP or Actor COMP feedback so modified channel values are injected at the next simulation step.

key_params.name: comp
key_params.note: Bullet Solver COMP or Actor COMP to inspect

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Sample rate for output CHOP data

common_gotchas: This CHOP is not a solver by itself; it reads a Bullet Solver COMP or Actor COMP.
Collision IDs map back to actor/body IDs, so downstream logic should keep those ID channels.
When used as Bullet feedback, modified CHOP values are injected at the start of the next simulation time step.
Choose world, solver, or actor transform space deliberately before exporting transforms.
Feedback loops can destabilize the simulation if rates, scopes, or body counts drift.
